steps.en: Install gnhf and sign in to the agent CLI it will drive
steps.zh: 安装 gnhf，并登录它要驱动的 agent 命令行

steps.en: In a clean git repo, start a run with an objective and a cap
steps.zh: 在干净的 git 仓库里，带目标和上限启动一次运行

steps.en: Creates a gnhf/ branch and a local run folder with prompt.md and notes.md
steps.zh: 新建 gnhf/ 分支和本地运行目录，存好 notes.md

steps.en: Each round calls your agent; success is committed, failure is hard-reset
steps.zh: 每轮调用你的 agent：成功就提交，失败就硬重置

steps.en: Waits out usage limits, stops at the cap, prints an exit summary
steps.zh: 等过用量窗口，到上限停下，打印退出摘要

steps.en: In the morning, review the branch commit by commit; keep, revert or cherry-pick
steps.zh: 早上逐个审查分支上的提交，保留、回退或挑拣

value.en: You wake up to small reviewable commits instead of one tangled diff or a run that died at midnight
value.zh: 醒来看到的是一串可逐个审查的小提交，而不是一坨混乱改动或半夜就停掉的运行
